thinkingLow.rationale: Pi paints its editor border with the thinking-level role; Claude's prompt border at /effort low is #888888.

thinkingMedium.rationale: Claude's prompt border at /effort medium (the default) is #888888. The spinner shares this role in Pi; the working-indicator adapter recolors the spinner.

thinkingHigh.rationale: Claude's prompt border at /effort high is #888888.

thinkingXhigh.rationale: Claude's prompt border at /effort xhigh is #888888.

thinkingMax.rationale: Claude's prompt border at /effort max is #888888.

toolDiffAdded.rationale: Claude's added-line gutter sign; the diff adapter recolors line content to #f8f8f2 and paints the line background.

toolDiffRemoved.rationale: Claude's removed-line gutter sign; the diff adapter recolors line content to #f8f8f2 and paints the line background.

bashMode.rationale: Claude's shell-mode marker color. Pi also uses the role for the bash-mode editor border, which Claude does not show in a capture.

mdLink.rationale: Claude draws link text in the terminal default color. Pi's forced underline stays; no public hook removes it.

searchMatchText.rationale: Claude's current search match color, ANSI yellow (index 3), with bold, underline, and inverse. Pi's own attributes differ; color only.
